description: This Java source file defines the EventSenderImpl class, a client implementation for publishing event messages to a Hono server using Vertx-Proton. It includes methods for creating senders, constructing target addresses, and sending messages with tracing support.

classes.name: EventSenderImpl
classes.description: A Vertx-Proton based client for publishing event messages to a Hono server, extending AbstractDownstreamSender with methods for creating senders and sending messages.

methods.name: getTargetAddress
methods.description: Constructs the AMQP target address for sending messages to a specific tenant and device.

methods.name: getTo
methods.description: Returns the target address for a given device ID.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new EventSenderImpl instance with a connection, tenant ID, and close hook.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome (Message)
methods.description: Sends a message and waits for the outcome, always with at least once delivery semantics.

methods.name: sendAndWaitForOutcome (Message, SpanContext)
methods.description: Sends a message with a parent span context and waits for the outcome.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends an AMQP message, setting it as durable, and waits for the outcome, with tracing support.

methods.name: startSpan
methods.description: Starts a new tracing span for forwarding an event message.
